_Account POV. Drawing the org and overlaying our engagement._

CoreFlow is an open opportunity, stage negotiation, $142K, close date 2026-09-11 (SFDC). Three Gong calls on record: Discovery 2026-06-17, Pricing Review 2026-06-22, QBR 2026-06-24.

Engagement concentration: all three Gong calls include Chris Jones (Head of Lifecycle Marketing, flagged as champion). Robert Smith (CMO) appeared on the Discovery call. Nicole Anderson, Daniel Davis, Stephanie Clark, and Nicole Williams each appeared on one call. The EngagementAdapter returned no rows, so email or web-session-level contact attribution isn't available to confirm who is driving recent site activity.

Where we have no relationships: Margaret Chen (CEO), Victor Osei (VP Engineering), and Priya Raman (VP Finance) have no Gong appearances on record. Priya Raman's confidence is 0.55, so her title and reporting line are worth verifying before relying on them. Tom Bradley (Staff Engineer, confidence 0.45) should be treated as low-confidence enrichment.

Champion and org placement: Chris Jones reports to Robert Smith (CMO), who reports to Margaret Chen. The champion sits in the marketing org, not a standalone People or HR function, which is worth noting given CoreFlow's industry (finance, 1,531 employees).

Open roles and recent hires: two postings for Head of Lifecycle Marketing detected 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-04 (linkedin.com/jobs/view/29c03ea7, linkedin.com/jobs/view/3fb10b41), and a Director of Lifecycle Marketing posting detected 2026-07-24 (linkedin.com/jobs/view/49b2ddff). All are located in ON, CA. The org chart also shows a Director of Lifecycle Marketing as an open role (confidence 0.80). Chris Jones is flagged as recently hired. Daniel Davis holds the same Head of Lifecycle Marketing title as Jones; whether these are distinct roles or a data duplication is unclear from the available data and worth verifying.

Funding signals carry conflicting figures: a $100M Series B detected 2026-07-01 (Bessemer lead), a $100M Series C detected 2026-07-28 (Accel lead), and a $15M Series C detected 2026-07-30 (a16z lead), all sourced to crunchbase.com/organization/corepay/funding_rounds. The round labels and amounts are inconsistent across signals; the Crunchbase page is the place to confirm which is current before characterizing the funding situation on a call.
